traceability.notes:
All acceptance criteria and listed requirements for docs/stories/001.0-DEV-PLUGIN-SETUP.story.md are fully implemented and verified.
• Core Functionality & Plugin Structure (REQ-PLUGIN-STRUCTURE, REQ-RULE-REGISTRY, REQ-NPM-PACKAGE, REQ-TYPESCRIPT, REQ-TEST-SETUP): – src/index.ts implements a standard ESLint plugin module in TypeScript, exporting a typed plugin object with rules, meta, and flat-config presets. – Rules are dynamically discovered from RULE_NAMES and loaded via require, with ES module default support, forming a rule registry. – package.json defines a proper publishable ESLint plugin package (main, types, files, peerDependency on ESLint v9+, build/test scripts). – Jest-based tests exist and pass, specifically targeting plugin export shape and behavior.
• ESLint v9 Flat Config Integration & Config System (REQ-ESLINT-COMPAT, REQ-CONFIG-SYSTEM): – src/index.ts provides TRACEABILITY_RULE_SEVERITIES, createTraceabilityFlatConfig(), and configs.recommended/strict arrays tailored for ESLint v9 flat config. – tests/config/flat-config-presets-integration.test.ts (passing) validates that these presets work correctly with ESLint v9 and enable the documented rules. – README and user-docs/eslint-9-setup-guide.md document installation and flat-config usage, satisfying the Integration and User Experience criteria.
• Error Handling (REQ-ERROR-HANDLING): – Rule loading is wrapped in try/catch, logging descriptive errors and providing a fallback RuleModule that reports an ESLint problem instead of failing plugin load. – pluginMeta resolution has robust fallbacks to ensure metadata never causes load failure. – tests/plugin-setup-error.test.ts and tests/cli-error-handling.test.ts validate these behaviors and currently pass.
• Documentation: – Developer guides (docs/eslint-plugin-development-guide.md, docs/custom-rules-development-guide.md) and user-facing docs (README.md, user-docs/eslint-9-setup-guide.md) exist and align with the story’s documentation expectations.
Given the passing targeted and full test runs and the current implementation state, this story is fully satisfied.
